title: Ziusudra/Utnapishtim's ark lands in the Ararat region
place_text: Shuruppak, Iraq to Mount Ararat, Armenia/Turkey

tellings.quote: Landing in the Mount Ararat region okay of uh Armenia turkey area

plain: A researcher called Matt, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, retells the ancient flood stories of Mesopotamia found in the Atrahasis and the Epic of Gilgamesh, poems from what is now Iraq. In them a hero, called Ziusudra or Utnapishtim, sets out from the city of Shuruppak in a great boat. Matt says the boat comes to rest in the Mount Ararat region, around today's Armenia and Turkey, which would tie these older tales closely to the story of Noah.
